notes: The UNO R4 Minima is not in the catalogue, so a new part type with only the used header ports (5V, GND, A0, A5) was created. The picture shows a different board outline.

The breadboard in the image has rows f-j in the top half and a-e in the bottom half. The catalogue names rows f-j bank 'b' and rows a-e bank 't', so I used those names. The pot's wiper is in column 14 at row f (top half). Its outer pins are in columns 13 and 15 at row e (bottom half).

The potentiometer's outer pins are wired as VCC (column 13, to the + rail by the red jumper) and GND (column 15, to the - rail by the black jumper). The wiper (SIG) goes to A5 via the yellow wire in column 14 (hole 14b.j).
Rail hole numbers are estimated from the picture. 5V goes to bp.2 (+ rail, lower row) and GND goes to bn.1 (- rail, upper row). The red jumper ends at bp.11. The black jumpers end at bn.12 and bn.25.

The buzzer legs are in columns 26 and 30 at row e. A0 (yellow wire) goes to column 26 row a, so A0 drives buzzer pin 1. A black jumper from column 30 row a goes to the GND rail, so buzzer pin 2 is ground. The buzzer's polarity is assumed.
The sketch's DAC output is on A0, which is why the buzzer is fed from A0. The potentiometer on A5 sets the frequency.
